Questions about recurring events
Limits, what bookers can change, and what doesn't combine yet.
Ask a question
How often can an event repeat, and how many times?
Every 1 to 20 weeks, months or years, for up to 32 occurrences. You set the maximum on the link.
Can a booker take fewer sessions than the maximum?
Yes. The booker shows the number of occurrences before they pick a time, and they can lower it to any number from 1 up to your maximum.
What happens around a clock change?
If a date in the series shifts because daylight saving time starts or ends, the booker marks it with a Time shift badge before anyone confirms.
Can I take payment or use seats on a recurring event?
Not yet. A link can't repeat and take payments, or repeat and have seats, at the same time.
Where do people find all their dates?
The confirmation lists the series and its dates, and the email with the calendar invitation goes to everyone when they book.
